Similarly, components that integrate OpenADR were using TSL encryption in their communications. 6.1.10.2 Subtask 10.1.1: Deploy the Cybersecurity Solution The developed Cybersecurity Framework included a series of defense mechanisms to address the identified vulnerabilities, which had been documented in detail in the Cybersecurity Plan. The different protection and mitigation security mechanisms had then been validated specifically for the Utah State University’s microgrid facility. Mapping of the Cybersecurity Framework at USU’s Microgrid Facility Hardware Assets Inventory: A detailed inventory of the physical devices that are part of the microgrid facility was maintained. HBOM management was being implemented 31 • Software Assets Inventory (Pending): A detailed inventory of the software components that are part of the microgrid facility was maintained. SBOM management was being implemented. • Data Flow Mapping (Implemented): USU maintained and updated regularly their data flow diagram that includes all the different components that conform their microgrid facility, with their respective communication protocols, IP/MAC addresses. • Awareness and Training (Implemented): The personnel involved in the design, implementation, and operation of the microgrid facility undergo regular cybersecurity training that includes access control, phishing prevention, and cybersecurity awareness • Physical Access Control (Implemented): EV chargers and DERs do not have active external ports. • Privileged Access Management (Implemented): The microgrid facility rigorously complies with NIST 800-171 and 53 frameworks, such that access to data and software is protected. Specific access to the Supercomputer Cluster supporting EVR simulation and data analysis is gated by restricted node access. Only authenticated systems with approved digital certificates can connect to these resources. • Remote Access Control (Implemented): The data portal https://aspire-data-portal.usu.edu is the primary interface for internal and partner access to ASPIRE datasets. It is protected by: • Two-factor authentication • Institutional identity tokens (CAS integration) • Role-based data access and tiered permissions This portal supports version-controlled data ingestion, active monitoring, and structured metadata tagging for all research datasets. The project team was developing audit-logging tools for project-specific compliance reporting. • Network Segmentation (Implemented): In addition to data access and compute protections, the connection to DERs within the EVR/microgrid facility was handled through a secured OpenADR VEN. This VEN operates behind internal firewalls and was tightly integrated with the EVR’s network architecture.
